summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The BrandywineGLOBAL - Dynamic US Large Cap Value ETF (DVAL) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the Russell 1000 Value index. The fund is actively managed to hold a portfolio of US large-cap value companies. Stocks are selected using a proprietary multi-factor approach. DVAL was launched on Dec 27, 2006 and is issued by Franklin Templeton.

holdings.infoBox: DVAL is an equity ETF with a total of 100 individual holdings. The top holdings are Cisco Systems stock at 4.06%, Bank of America at 3.98%, Wells Fargo & Company at 3.78%, GE Aerospace at 3.52%, and United Parcel Service at 3.36%.
